core_obligations: Pass to the closure of the complement of the closed subset in the generic fibre and spread it to a neighbourhood.
Show the spread closure does not contain any fibre over a nonempty open, so the subset stays nowhere dense.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the closure of the complement of the subset.
Spread the closure to a neighbourhood of the generic point.
Show the fibres over a dense open are not swallowed.

difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base, if a closed subset is nowhere dense in the generic fibre then it is nowhere dense in every fibre over a nonempty open. The proof passes to the closure of the complement of the subset, spreads that closure to a neighbourhood using finite type and the irreducibility of the base, and then shows that the spread closure does not swallow any fibre over the open. Keeping the spread closure off the fibres is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 6532-6560.
